info.title: Urja Meter API
info.description: Urja portal adapter: session login, meter search, nameplates, location and hierarchy, readings, and transformer listing. Protected calls use X-Urja-Session. Source data is fetched live; measurement timestamps may be old.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Login and logout using Urja session credentials.

tags.name: Search
tags.description: Portal meter search by ID or serial (paginated or all pages).

tags.name: Meters
tags.description: Single-meter nameplate, location, readings, overview, and signed export.

tags.name: Query
tags.description: Export-backed attribute filters and nearby search.

tags.name: Transformers
tags.description: Transformer catalogue, assigned meters, and inventory summary.

post.description: Five attempts per minute per IP; returns session only after a fresh cookie-only search succeeds.

502.description: Malformed, unsupported or oversized upstream response. Not retried.

503.description: SERVICE_BUSY, PORTAL_RATE_LIMITED, or PORTAL_UNAVAILABLE. Eligible transient GET failures have at most one shared retry.

Retry-After.description: For PORTAL_RATE_LIMITED, a valid upstream hint bounded to 1–60 seconds. Omitted for invalid hints.

504.description: Attempt or total operation deadline exceeded.

post.description: Forwards the supplied Urja session cookie to the observed sign-out endpoint and succeeds only when Urja confirms logout and clears the session cookie. The session is not retried after an uncertain failure.

get.summary: Get available readings with optional time filters
get.description: Checks meter existence, fetches available readings once, then filters locally. Results are chronological and duplicates are preserved with warnings. Numeric energy values are source registers; no interval totals are calculated. available_from/to describe the entire source before filtering. Timezone is unknown; source data may be old.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive boundary; from must be <= to.

parameters.description: Inclusive boundary; from must be <= to.

get.summary: Export all meter metadata and locations
get.description: Authenticated server-side signed bulk retrieval. No query parameters. Complete normalized snapshot or error; excludes reading time series. Preserves hierarchy aliases. No signing material exposed or persisted. Upstream limit 5 MiB and 10000 rows.

502.description: Malformed/incomplete export, conflicting identities, response exceeding 5 MiB decompressed, or more than 10000 rows.

UrjaSession.name: X-Urja-Session
UrjaSession.description: Urja session cookie value returned by login. Send the raw value without a Bearer prefix.

LocalTimestamp.description: Calendar-valid local timestamp. Timezone is unknown; no Z or offset is accepted.
